description: Yoke's dependency updates: Renovate on our Forgejo since 2026-11-15, when Yoke's canonical repository moved there (GitHub is its mirror). Estate defaults come from the preset emiluzelac/renovate-config. npm patch and minor updates of 1.x-and-later packages merge themselves once Renovate has seen CI pass (lint, format, compile, tests, VSIX package); they reach users only in the next release (scripts/release.mjs). 0.x packages wait for review.

packageRules.description: npm patch, minor and digest updates of 1.x-and-later packages merge themselves after green CI, squashed.
A 0.x npm package may break in any release: its own PR, reviewed.

@types/vscode must not be newer than engines.vscode: vsce refuses to package otherwise, and raising engines.vscode drops users on older VS Code. Move both together, by hand, when the floor is raised (carried over from Dependabot's ignore).
